title: Talking Devices
about: For the Visveswaraya Industrial and Technological Museum in Bangalore, in partnership with Workbench Projects and the India Foundation for the Arts, I designed and built three interactive installations around vintage communication devices — turning objects most visitors would only ever see behind glass into things they could actually use.
role: Interaction Designer + Installation Artist — conceptualising, wiring, and fabricating all three pieces myself, from the electronics to the physical builds.
tools: Vintage communication devices, electronics (MP3 modules, motors, switches), fabrication
outcome: Record Lathe let visitors record their own voice and watch it cut a physical groove into a real record, then play it back. Talking Telephones wired antique phones with MP3 modules so picking up the receiver played snippets of old-style phone conversations. Change the Channel turned radio tuning into a two-person, room-scale game, connecting a radio's frequency dial to a physical floor-strip scale of wavelengths.
